observation.happening: Google Meet call transcript view displaying automatically captured or manually recorded meeting notes organized by category (Live memo, Decided things, Costs, To-do, Questions) with timestamps and speaker names
observation.most_important: Clean hierarchical note organization system with category-based grouping of meeting captures
observation.next_action: Navigate through transcript categories, edit notes, or continue meeting discussion
anomalies: Notes appear organized but visual weight between categories is flat
Unclear if this is live-captured or manually edited notes

9539.why: Functional meeting notes interface with helpful category-based organization, but the overall design follows generic list patterns without distinctive visual or interactive elements. The layout serves its purpose well but doesn't stand out compared to best-in-class products.

observation.happening: Alert dialog indicating network failure while attempting to send a quote response to client. Orange warning icon with retry option.
observation.most_important: User must retry sending a critical document (quote response) that failed to transmit
observation.next_action: Tap 'やり直す' to retry, or close with X button
anomalies: Error message ambiguity: unclear whether 'send' was completed before connection dropped
No details about what triggered the connection loss or whether data will be resent safely

97C1.why: Clean, minimal error dialog with appropriate warning styling, but the error message is cryptic and doesn't clearly communicate what actually happened or guarantee that retry will succeed. Good execution of a standard pattern, but messaging could be significantly clearer.

observation.happening: Minimal header bar from Google Meet showing app name, call duration timestamp, and top-level action buttons (Notes, Captions, Ask Astra) with recording indicator
observation.most_important: Clean header design with core meeting controls in correct visual hierarchy
observation.next_action: Access notes, enable captions, or invoke Astra assistant
anomalies: This is only the header - insufficient context to evaluate full interface state

9A14.why: Only a header bar is visible - not enough UI substance to make a meaningful design judgment. The header itself is clean and well-executed, but full interface context is required.

observation.happening: Simple product label/logo showing Notion app identifier with dropdown indicator
anomalies: Extremely minimal UI - only branding label visible

A849.why: This is only a product label/header element with no substantive UI to evaluate. Too minimal to assess design quality meaningfully.

observation.happening: Three-button toolbar with Open (left icon), Record (center circle icon), and Open (grid icon) buttons arranged horizontally
observation.most_important: Both left and right buttons label as '開く' (Open) despite having distinctly different icons, creating user confusion about what each button actually does
observation.next_action: Tap any button to trigger Open or Record action
anomalies: Duplicate label '開く' on both left and right buttons suggests either labeling error or very different operations with confusingly identical names
Icon designs are clearly different but labels don't differentiate them

AA11.why: The duplicate 'Open' labels on functionally distinct buttons is a concrete UX defect that creates user confusion. While the visual design is clean, this labeling error undermines usability. A user cannot distinguish what each '開く' button actually does.

observation.happening: Google Meet recording interface with active transcription panel, meeting notes sidebar (showing categories: Decided/To-do), and device configuration warning. Three-column layout: playback controls at top, left sidebar for meeting info/warnings, center panel for transcription (Original/Translation/Live tabs)
observation.most_important: Configuration error blocking audio input - device codec not supported on this Mac, preventing proper meeting recording and transcription
observation.next_action: Tap '設定を開く' to resolve audio codec issue, or continue without proper audio capture
anomalies: Error message text is truncated ('この Mac ではオ' and following lines appear cut off or malformed)
Transcription panel shows 'No speech detected yet' despite recording being supposedly active - suggests either no audio is being captured or transcription system has failed
Inconsistent state: recording controls show active/running but transcript is completely empty
Red error text overlaps with other content and creates visual noise without providing complete solution

ABC5.why: Multiple concrete defects: (1) Error message is truncated, making it impossible to fully understand the problem, (2) State inconsistency - recording shows active but transcription panel is empty with 'No speech detected', (3) Red error text creates visual stress and doesn't fit properly. These are not minor polish issues but functional/clarity defects that undermine user confidence and ability to troubleshoot.
